entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Face, mouth, smile, eyebrows; Concern, sympathy, comfort, warmth
entries.zh: 脸、嘴、微笑、眉毛；关切、同情、安慰、温暖。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 柔和、温暖、平静、同情、令人安心。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 给予、闪现；拉拢、转变。

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 神情变得温柔而充满同情

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Gave her a look of concern
entries.zh: 投给她关切的目光

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 把双眉轻轻蹙在一起

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Mouth turned down at the corners
entries.zh: 嘴角往下垂

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 露出一个安慰的微笑

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: His face turned soft and sympathetic and his voice sank to a murmur.
entries.zh: 他的神情变得柔和而同情，声音也放低成了轻语。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She drew her eyebrows together and turned her mouth down in a look of concern.
entries.zh: 她双眉微蹙，嘴角下垂，显出关切的神情。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 平静、耐心、令人安心；柔和、温暖。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 凝望、看；发亮、放光。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 平静而令人安心

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 像天鹅绒一样柔软

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Beamed with warmth, like candles in the dark
entries.zh: 像黑暗中的蜡烛一样散发暖意

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her brown eyes were like velvet – warm and comforting.
entries.zh: 她的棕眼睛像天鹅绒，温暖又令人安心。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: As she looked down on him, her eyes beamed with warmth, like candles in the dark.
entries.zh: 她低头看着他，眼里的暖光像黑暗中的烛火。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.zh: 叹息、耳语、轻声细语。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.en: Soft, warm, low, silky, mild; Gentle, calm, patient, comforting
entries.zh: 轻柔、温暖、低声、丝滑、温和；温柔、平静、耐心、抚慰人心。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.en: Whispered, sighed; Sank, trailed off; Comforted, reassured
entries.zh: 耳语、叹息；低下去、渐弱消失；安慰、使安心。

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 低低的叹息

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 轻得只是耳语

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.en: Silky and soft, like a feathery whisper
entries.zh: 丝绸般柔和，像羽毛一样轻的低语

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 温和而耐心的嗓音

entries.label: Phrases – Nouns and Adjectives
entries.zh: 话语温柔，给人安慰

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 在他耳边低声说

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 轻轻叹气

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 发出安抚的声音

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 声音变得轻柔低缓

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Trailed off to a low sigh
entries.zh: 声音渐低，化作一声轻叹

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her voice was silky and soft, like a feathery whisper.
entries.zh: 她的声音丝绸般柔和，像羽毛一样轻的耳语。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She held him close and murmured soothingly.
entries.zh: 她把他紧紧搂在身边，低声安慰。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her voice was low and soft and her words gentle and comforting.
entries.zh: 她声音低而柔，话语温暖且令人安心。

entries.label: Nouns
entries.en: Arm, hand, hair, head; Gesture, squeeze, support
entries.zh: 手臂、手、头发、头；动作、轻握、支持。

entries.label: Adjectives
entries.zh: 轻柔、温和。

entries.label: Verbs
entries.zh: 轻轻伸入、环抱；抱着、抚摸、轻握。

entries.label: Adverbs
entries.zh: 紧紧地、亲切地、温柔地、平静地、安抚地。

entries.label: Phrases and Adjectives
entries.zh: 轻轻捏握一下

entries.label: Phrases and Adjectives
entries.zh: 表示支持的动作

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Slid her arm around his shoulder
entries.zh: 把手臂轻轻搭到他的肩上

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 轻轻搂她一下

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 抚摸他的头发

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 把头稍稍前倾

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 把她抱在自己腹前

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.zh: 双臂紧紧环抱他

entries.label: Phrases – Verbs
entries.en: Squeezed his arm in a gesture of support
entries.zh: 轻握他的手臂以示支持

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She gave him a loving look and hugged him tightly to her.
entries.zh: 她深情地看着他，把他紧紧抱在怀里。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He tilted his head forward and flashed a comforting smile.
entries.zh: 他微微前倾着头，露出安慰的微笑。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She held John to her stomach and wrapped her arms around him.
entries.zh: 她把约翰揽到腹前，双臂环抱着他。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: She slid her arm around Kitty’s shoulder, gave her a gentle squeeze and whispered in her ear.
entries.zh: 她轻轻搂住基蒂的肩膀，安抚地捏了捏，又在她耳边低语。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Her voice trailed off into a low sigh and she squeezed Robert’s arm in a gesture of support.
entries.zh: 她的声音渐弱，化成一声低叹；她轻握罗伯特的手臂，表示支持。
